data.body:
Close gate refused: commit b63cf799 (Install bubblewrap on the Linux CI lanes) carries this ticket's trailer and changes .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml and _mutation.yml, which file_impact did not declare — work beyond the reviewed plan. Widened file_impact to all 8 paths.

Checked the full set rather than fixing one path at a time: four commits carry this ticket's trailer (a26a7327, a1d85864, b63cf799, dfc1eb4d) touching eight files, now all declared. A fifth commit (3b28514) appears in a naive message grep but is trailered to 6818 and only MENTIONS this ticket as its split parent; the gate correctly ignored it.

Widening is a material plan change, so the attestation goes stale and review-plan re-runs before the close.
